tasks.subject: Task 1: CommonPage::waitForCondition
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reusable helper polling a JS expression until truthy or timeout, so page objects can wait on state instead of navigation.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/Pages/CommonPage.php
- Test: tests/Unit/Pages/WaitForConditionTest.php

**Verify:** vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter WaitForCondition

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Pages/CommonPage.php", "tests/Unit/Pages/WaitForConditionTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter WaitForCondition", "acceptanceCriteria": ["waitForCondition(string,int,int): bool exists on CommonPage", "returns true on first truthy result and stops polling", "returns false when the timeout expires", "a JS error or an evaluate() exception counts as not-yet-true"]}
```

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Pages/v9/FrontOffice/OnePageCheckout/Page.php", "tests/Unit/Pages/OnePageCheckoutPageTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit --filter OnePageCheckoutPage", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extends Common\\FrontOffice\\Page, url 'order', pageTitle 'Checkout'", "methods: isOnePageCheckoutActive, continueAsGuest, selectAddress, fillNewAddress, selectFirstCarrier, selectFirstPayment, acceptTerms, placeOrder", "no sleep(): every AJAX wait goes through waitForCondition()"]}
```
